trace.final:
**Summary:**

1. **Diagnosed:** checkout-api (v2.3.1) was unhealthy in all regions with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back:** The first rollback attempt partially failed (completed us-east only, then hit an orchestrator error), leaving mixed versions. A retry completed the rollback — all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) are now on **v2.3.0**.
3. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is healthy again, error rate back down to 0.2%.
4. **Incident:** Opened **INC-0002** (SEV2) describing the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the partial-failure rollback, and final recovery — on-call engineer has been paged.
